item.title: ▫️ Security as common language The Directorate of the Chief of Engineer Troops of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation together with Laos partners organised
item.description: Security as common language ▫️ The Directorate of the Chief of Engineer Troops of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation together with Laos partners organised the humanitarian demining exercise for the countries that are members of the ADMM-Plus in the first decade of September at the Nizhny Novgorod Guards Higher Military Engineering Command School. 🤝 By coordination of the Main Directorate for International Military Cooperation, more than 100 servicemen from Brunei, Cambodia, China, India, Laos, Malaysia, Myanmar, the Philippines, Thailand, and Vietnam took part in the event. ⏩ The servicemen improved their skills of humanitarian demining, combat coordination of engineering units, unexploded ordnance disposal, and the use of special hardware. Modern ground robotic systems were actively used. The exercise was highly appreciated by all member countries. 📆 The final session on the results of the three-year Russian-Lao chairmanship of the ADMM-Plus expert working group on humanitarian demining will take place in Laos in 2027. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ❗️ The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.

item.content:encoded:

The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
❗️
Units of the Sever Group of Forces in Kharkov region continue to tighten the encirclement
of the enemy's formations and expand the external control zone.
🚩
I
n the encirclement ring, Russian troops have liberated Shirokoye (Kharkov region)
and actively carry out intensive operations to liberate Malaya Volchya (Kharkov region).
💥
The coordinated fire damage was inflicted
on enemy manpower and hardware close to Rybalkino and Buzovo (Kharkov region). The Group's units continue to neutralise blocked units of the AFU near Olkhovatka in Kharkov region.
▪️
Within 24 hours, the enemy lost up to 60 troops and one armoured fighting vehicle with manpower during an attempt to leave the area of Chernoye (Kharkov region).
▪️
Since the beginning of the month,
up to 460 militants, 13 armoured fighting vehicles, eight pickup trucks, 13 ATVs, and 21 ground robotic systems have been neutralised.
🚩
As a result of resolute actions to expand the external control zone,
Russian troops liberated Shevchenkovo (Kharkov region)
and inflicted losses on the enemy's formations near Novoaleksandrovka and Prikolotnoye (Kharkov region).
🔥
In addition,
units of one motorised infantry brigade and one assault regiment of the AFU have been hit close to Martynovka and Chernoglazovka (Kharkov region).
💥
Strikes were delivered at manpower and hardware of two enemy's territorial defence brigades close to Boyaro-Lezhachi, Barilovka, and Radkovka (Sumy region).
📊
In total, within 24 hours, in the Sever Group's area of responsibility, the enemy has lost
up to 200 troops, one U.S.-made M113 armoured personnel carrier, two armoured fighting vehicles, 14 motor vehicles, one field artillery gun, and ten UGVs.
📍
The Zapad Group of Forces improved the situation along the front line.
Losses were inflicted on formations of two mechanised brigades, one airmobile brigade of the AFU, and one territorial defence brigade near Starodubovka, Karpovka, Rubtsy (Donetsk People's Republic), and Peski Radkovskiye (Kharkov region).
▪️
The enemy losses amounted to up to 215 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, 11 motor vehicles, one field artillery gun, and one electronic reconnaissance station.
📍
The Yuzhnaya Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions.
Russian elements inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of four mechanised brigades of the AFU and one marine brigade near Druzhkovka, Vasilevskaya Pustosh, Slavyansk, Klinovoye, Kramatorsk, Rayskoye, and Nikolayevka (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to up to 170 troops, two field artillery guns, including one U.S.-made 155-mm M777 howitzer, and 21 motor vehicles.
👉

as of 14 September 2026

📍
The Tsentr Group's units improved the tactical situation.
Strikes were delivered at formations of three mechanised brigades of the AFU, one marine brigade, one national guard brigade, and one special operations brigade near Shilovka, Andreyevka, Belozerskoye, Yuryevka (Donetsk People's Republic), and Novotroitskoye (Dnepropetrovsk region).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to more than 460 troops, four armoured fighting vehicles, 11 motor vehicles, and two artillery guns.
↗️
The Vostok Group's units advanced to the depth of the enemy's defence.
The Group's elements inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of one mechanised brigade, two air assault brigades, two assault regiments of the AFU, and one marine brigade close to Mikhaylovskoye, Obshcheye, Voskresenka, Slavnoye (Zaporozhye region), Otrishki, Kolomiytsy, and Pavlovka (Dnepropetrovsk region).
▪️
The enemy lost up to 290 troops, one armoured personnel carrier, six motor vehicles, and one field artillery gun.
🚩
The Dnepr Group's units took more advantageous lines and positions and liberated Novoandreyevka in Zaporozhye region.
💥
Strikes were delivered
at manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades of the AFU and one territorial defence brigade near Orekhov, Preobrazhenka, Yurkovka, and Balabino (Zaporozhye region).
▪️
Up to 40 troops, one artillery gun, 26 motor vehicles, and one electronic warfare station were neutralised.
✈️
Operational-Tactical Aviation, attack drones, missile troops, and artillery of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation have inflicted damage
on Ukrainian logistics centres, power and transport infrastructure, assembly and storage facilities of unmanned aerial vehicles, as well as temporary deployment areas of Ukrainian armed formations and foreign mercenaries in 142 areas.
▫️
Air defence systems shot down
four guided aerial bombs, four U.S.-made HIMARS MLRS projectiles, two Neptune long-range guided missiles, and 1,025 fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicles.
⚓️
The Black Sea Fleet destroyed one uncrewed surface vehicle of the Ukrainian Navy in the Black Sea waters.
📊

since the beginning of the special military operation, the enemy

284

tanks and other armoured fighting vehicles,
▫️
1,777
MLRS combat vehicles,
▫️
36,454
field artillery guns and mortars,
▫️
71,878
special military vehicles.

item.title: 👊 Derailing AFU train echelons The Geran-4 Seeker UAVs hit enemy military train echelons and locomotives
item.description: 👊 Derailing AFU train echelons The Geran-4 Seeker UAVs hit enemy military train echelons and locomotives in Dnepropetrovsk, Zaporozhye, Poltava, Nikolayevka, and Odessa regions. In order to reduce the logistical capabilities of the AFU, Russian troops continue to launch systematic strikes against the enemy's transport infrastructure. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

Derailing AFU train echelons

in Dnepropetrovsk, Zaporozhye, Poltava, Nikolayevka, and Odessa regions.
